blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is an effective way to strengthen the long-context reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but it needs training data that are long, diverse, challenging, and verifiable. Human annotation of such data is expensive, naturally occurring data are too scarce to sustain RL, and existing synthesis methods depend on external corpora or stronger teacher models, which become harder to obtain as the trained models get stronger. Recently, RL from zero data, in which a model learns from tasks it proposes itself, has achieved excellent performance, but existing methods target short-context tasks. Therefore, we propose $\textbf{LongZero}$, a method that lets an LLM improve its own long-context reasoning without any external data. Instead of writing questions and answers over existing documents, LongZero first has the model synthesize the question and answer with its supporting evidence in a compact structured form, and only then separately expands the evidence into a long multi-document context. LongZero combines these self-written multi-hop reasoning tasks with self-written multi-round retrieval tasks and trains the model with GRPO. We evaluate LongZero on two LLMs across five long-context reasoning benchmarks and compare it with RL on data synthesized from external corpora. Experimental results show that LongZero can generalize to real tasks, and outperforms both baselines, suggesting a viable and promising path to improving long-context reasoning of LLMs.
blocks.zh: 强化学习(RL)是加强大语言模型(LLMs)长文本推理的有效途径,但它需要长期,多样,具有挑战性和可核查性的培训数据. 人类对此类数据的注释很昂贵,自然出现的数据太少,无法维持RL,而现有的合成方法依赖于外部的Corpora或更强的师范模型,随着训练有素的模型变得更强而变得更难获得. 最近,一个模型从零数据中学习到它自己提出的任务的RL取得了优异的性能,但现有方法以短写任务为目标. 因此,我们提议 $\textbf{ LongZero}$, 这个方法可以让 LLM 在没有任何外部数据的情况下改进自己的长文本推理 。 LongZero没有在现有文档上写问答,而是先由模型以紧凑的结构形式用支持性证据来综合问答,而后再单独地将证据扩展为长多文档上下文. 长 Zero将这些自写多跳推理任务与自写多轮取回任务结合起来,并用GRPO来训练模型. 我们评价了LongZero在两个LLMs上的5个长文本推理基准,并与外部公司合成的数据RL比较。 实验结果表明,LongZero可以概括到实际任务,并且表现优于这两个基线,为改进LLMs的长写推理提出了一条可行而有希望的道路.

blocks.en:
Reasoning over long context, such as collections of reports, long conversations, or entire books, is required in many applications of large language models (LLMs) ( Bai et al., 2025 ; Krishna et al., 2025 ) .
Following the success of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) on short-context reasoning ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2025 ; Lambert et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025b ) , a growing body of work applies RL to long-context reasoning ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Shen et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
These studies consistently show that training data are a decisive factor: useful RL data demand (i) substantial length, (ii) evidence retrieval and consolidation, (iii) sufficient difficulty for producing a learning signal, and (iv) automatically verifiable answers ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Lv et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
在大语言模型的许多应用中,需要以长背景为理由,例如收集报告、长对话或全书(Bai等人,2025年;Krishna等人,2025年)。
在以可核查的奖励加强短文推理学习(RLVR)取得成功(Deep Seek-AI等人,2025年;Team等人,2025年;Lambert等人,2024年;Yu等人,2025年b)之后,越来越多的工作将长文推理(Wan等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年a); 沈等,2025;陈等,2026).
这些研究一致表明,培训数据是一个决定性因素:有用的RL数据需求(一)长度大,(二)证据检索和整理,(三)产生学习信号的足够困难,(四)自动可核实的答案(Wang等人,2025a); 徐等人,2026; Lv等人,2026).

blocks.en:
Data with all of these properties are difficult to obtain.
Human annotation of long-context questions is expensive, and naturally occurring long-context QA data are far scarcer than what RL consumes.
Existing pipelines therefore build training tasks from existing resources (Figure 1 a): they extend short multi-hop QA datasets with distractor documents ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , ask a model to write questions over real documents ( Yang et al., 2025b ; Shen et al., 2025 ; Lv et al., 2026 ) , combine knowledge graphs with search-agent trajectories ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , or simply rely on a stronger teacher model to generate training data ( Mukherjee et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024b ) .
All of these approaches depend on external data or models. Real-world facts also introduce a confound: a model may answer from its parametric knowledge instead of the given context ( Longpre et al., 2021 ) , and public text may overlap with evaluation data ( Sainz et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
很难获得所有这些属性的数据。
人类对长文问题的注释很昂贵,自然发生的长文QA数据比RL消耗量要少得多.
因此,现有管道利用现有资源(图1a):利用分散文件(Wang等人,2025年a)扩展短的多跳QA数据集,请一个模型在真实文件上写问题(Yang等人,2025年b; 沈某1等人,2025年;Lv等人,2026年),将知识图与搜索剂轨迹(林某1等人,2026年)相结合,或者简单地依靠更强的师范模型生成培训数据(Mukherjee等人,2023年;刘某1等人,2024年b).
所有这些方法都取决于外部数据或模型。 现实世界的事实也引入了一个困惑:一个模型可能从其参数学知识而不是特定上下文来回答(Longpre等人,2021年),公共文本可能与评价数据重叠(Sainz等人,2023年).

blocks.en:
At the same time, RL from zero data has emerged as an alternative to curated training sets.
In these methods the model proposes its own tasks and learns from solving them ( Zhao et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) .
This line of work has achieved excellent performance in short-context domains, such as mathematics, code, games, and tool-using agents ( Xia et al., 2025 ; Yue et al., 2026 ; Acikgoz et al., 2026 ) .
This leads to our research question: Can an LLM also improve its long-context reasoning from zero data?
blocks.zh:
同时,零数据中的RL也出现了,作为全科培训的替代.
在这些方法中,该模型提出了自己的任务,并学习如何解决这些问题(Zhao等人,2025a); Huang等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年).
本行工作在数学,代码,游戏,工具使用剂等短文领域取得了优异的成绩(霞等,2025年;岳等,2026年;阿西考兹等,2026年).
这导致我们的研究问题: 一个LLM能否从零数据中改进它的长文推理?

blocks.en:
Long-context tasks are harder to synthesize from zero data: a task consists of a long input together with a question about it, and the model must produce both.
Letting the model write a long document and then pose a question about it inherits the very weakness the task is meant to address, since a model that cannot yet reason reliably over long contexts cannot reliably write or verify questions about the long text it has just written.
Our key observation is that the order of generation can be reversed.
If the model first writes the question, evidence, and answer as a short structured specification, and only then expands the evidence into a long multi-document context, the answer is fixed before any long text exists, and the only remaining risk of error lies in the expansion.
blocks.zh:
长文本任务更难从零数据中合成:一个任务由长输入和关于它的问题组成,模型必须产生两者.
让模型写一个长的文件,然后对它提出问题,这继承了任务要解决的弱点,因为一个在长的语境中尚不能可靠地说明理由的模型无法可靠地写出或核实关于它刚刚写的长文本的问题。
我们的关键观察是,世代的顺序可以颠倒.
如果模型首先将问题,证据,和答案写成一个短的结构化的规格,只有这样,才能将证据扩展成一个长的多文档上下文,那么答案就固定在任何长文本存在之前,唯一剩下的错误风险就在于扩展.

blocks.en:
Building on this observation, we propose LongZero (Figure 1 b). LongZero uses the model being trained to synthesize two complementary kinds of long-context tasks: reasoning tasks, in which multi-hop questions over a fictional world must be answered from eight model-written documents, and retrieval tasks in the style of multi-round co-reference resolution (MRCR; Vodrahalli et al., 2024 ), in which the model must reproduce one specific earlier response in a long, model-written conversation.
The same model then answers each reasoning question several times, and only the questions it sometimes answers correctly and sometimes incorrectly are kept, because these are the questions on which group-relative policy optimization (GRPO; Shao et al., 2024 ) receives a non-zero learning signal.
blocks.zh:
基于这一看法,我们提议LongZero(图1b)。 LongZero使用正在接受训练的模型来综合两种互补的长文本任务:推理任务,其中跨虚构世界的多跳问题必须从8个模型书面文档中解答,以及多回合共参考解析风格的检索任务(MRCR;Vodrahalli et al., 2024),其中模型必须在一个长的,模型书面的对话中复制一个特定的早期响应.
同一模型随后多次回答每个推理问题,只有它有时正确和有时错误地回答的问题被保留下来,因为这些问题是哪个集团关系政策优化(GRPO;Shao等人,2024年)收到一个非零学习信号的问题.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: • We propose LongZero , a long-context RL method in which the LLM itself first synthesizes the question, evidence, and answer in a structured format, then expands them into long-context data, and is finally trained on these data. • We evaluate LongZero on two base models and five long-context reasoning benchmarks, and experimental results show that LongZero can generalize from self-generated tasks to general long-context reasoning tasks. • We compare LongZero with two synthetic-data baselines built from external corpora, and experimental results show that LongZero outperforms both baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of LongZero in improving long-context reasoning of LLMs without external data.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下: 我们提出LongZero——一种长文本的RL方法,LLM本身首先以结构化的格式将问题,证据和答案综合起来,然后将其扩展为长文本数据,最后接受这些数据的培训. ^ 我们用两个基础模型和五个长文本推理基准来评价LongZero,实验结果显示,LongZero可以概括从自我产生的任务到一般的长文本推理任务. 我们比较了LongZero与两个由外部蝎子构建的合成数据基线,实验结果显示,LongZero的表现优于这两个基线,表明LLMs在没有外部数据的情况下,LongZero在改进长文本推理方面的效力.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Learning without human data dates back to self-play systems such as AlphaGo Zero ( Silver et al., 2017 ) , and LLMs have long been used to generate their own instructions, rationales, or rewards ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Zelikman et al., 2022 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ) .
Since RLVR became the standard recipe for reasoning ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025 ) , two lines of work have reduced its reliance on curated data.
The first removes labels: rewards are derived from majority voting ( Zuo et al., 2025 ) or from the model’s own confidence ( Zhao et al., 2025b ) .
The second removes the questions themselves: the model proposes tasks and learns from solving them, verified by code execution in Absolute Zero ( Zhao et al., 2025a ) , by a co-evolving challenger and solver in R-Zero ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , or by asymmetric self-play from a single topic prompt ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , and the idea has been extended to games ( Liu et al., 2025 ) and agents ( Xia et al., 2025 ; Yue et al., 2026 ) .
Programmatic task generators play a similar role for logic puzzles ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Stojanovski et al., 2025 ) .
All of these methods target short-context tasks, where a task is a short string; in long-context reasoning, the long context must itself be synthesized and kept consistent with the question and answer, which is the problem LongZero addresses.
blocks.zh:
没有人类数据的学习可以追溯到AlphaGo Zero(Silver等人,2017年)等自玩系统,LLMs长期以来被用于生成自己的指令,原理,或奖励(Wang等人,2023年;Zelikman等人,2022年;Yuan等人,2024年).
自从RLVR成为推理的标准配方(Deep Seek-AI等人,2025年)以来,两条工作线减少了对编译数据的依赖.
第一个去除标签:奖励来源于多数投票(Zuo等人,2025年)或模型本身的信心(Zhao等人,2025年b).
其二 移除问题本身:模型提出任务并学习解题,通过绝对零(赵等人,2025a)的代码执行,R-Zero(黄等人,2025年)的共演挑战者和解题者验证,或从单一话题提示(陈等人,2025年)中非对称自玩,这个想法已经扩展到游戏(刘等人,2025年)和代理(夏等人,2025年;岳等人,2026年).
程序任务生成器在逻辑谜题方面起到类似的作用(谢等人,2025年;斯托亚诺夫斯基等人,2025年)。
所有这些方法都以短写任务为目标,其中任务是一个短串;在长写推理中,长上下文本身必须被合成,并与问答保持一致,这就是LongZero地址的问题.

blocks.en:
Long-context ability is usually built by context extension and continued pre-training ( Peng et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2024 ) , followed by fine-tuning on synthetic long-context data ( Bai et al., 2024a ; An et al., 2024 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ) .
RL has recently been applied directly to long-context reasoning, and most work focuses on how to construct training tasks: QwenLong-L1 and QwenLong-L1.5 write questions over real documents ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2025 ) , LoongRL hides HotpotQA questions behind UUID chains among distractors ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , SPELL lets one model question, answer, and verify over raw documents ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , LongTraceRL builds questions from knowledge-graph walks and search trajectories ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , and GoLongRL curates a multi-task mixture ( Lv et al., 2026 ) .
Other work improves the reward, for example with verifiable context rewards ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , or processes long inputs with memory agents ( Yu et al., 2025a ) .
These methods all obtain their contexts or questions from existing corpora, QA datasets, knowledge bases, or larger models; LongZero synthesizes both with the model being trained and is complementary to better rewards and algorithms.
blocks.zh:
长文本能力通常通过上下文扩展和连续的预训建立(Peng等人,2024;Fu等人,2024;Gao等人,2024),然后对合成长文本数据进行微调(Bai等人,2024a); An等人,2024年;Xiong等人,2024年).
最近RL被直接应用于长文推理,大部分工作侧重于如何构建培训任务:QuenLong-L1和QuenLong-L1.5在真实文件中写问题(Wan等人,2025年;Shen等人,2025年),Loong。 RL隐藏了UUID链条后面的热点QA问题在分散器(Wang等人,2025a),SPELL让一个模型提问,回答,并在原始文件上验证(Yang等人,2025b),LongTraceRL从知识地图行走和搜索轨迹中构建问题(Lin等人,2026),GolongRL解析一个多任务混合物(Lv等人,2026).
其他工作改进了奖励,例如,可核查的背景奖励(Chen等人,2026年),或用记忆剂处理长期投入(Yu等人,2025a年)。
这些方法都从现有的corpora,QA数据集,知识基础,或更大的模型中获取其背景或问题; LongZero结合正在训练的模型合成两者,是对更好的奖励和算法的补充.

blocks.en: Early evaluations relied on synthetic retrieval probes such as RULER ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) , which revealed, for instance, that models miss information in the middle of long inputs ( Liu et al., 2024a ) . Benchmarks have since moved toward realistic tasks and reasoning, such as LongBench and LongBench v2 ( Bai et al., 2024b ; Bai et al., 2025 ) , MRCR ( Vodrahalli et al., 2024 ) , LongReason ( Ling et al., 2025 ) , and AA-LCR ( Artificial Analysis, 2025 ) .

blocks.en:
LongZero synthesizes two kinds of data: reasoning data 𝒟 rea \mathcal{D}_{\text{rea}} , which require finding facts scattered across long documents, rejecting similar-looking distractors, and combining the facts into an answer, and retrieval data 𝒟 ret \mathcal{D}_{\text{ret}} , which require locating and reproducing one specific item among many similar ones in a long conversation.

blocks.en:
A reasoning sample is drawn from a world : a set of fictional entities and facts rendered as M M long documents of different genres, together with multi-hop questions that require combining facts from different documents.
The difficulty of a question q q over a context x x grows with the length of the context, the number of hops, and the number of distractors: Difficulty ⁡ ( x , q ) ∝ | x | ⋅ H q ⋅ K q , \operatorname{Difficulty}(x,q)\propto|x|\cdot H_{q}\cdot K_{q}, (1) where | x | |x| is the number of tokens in x x , H q H_{q} is the number of hops of q q , and K q K_{q} is the number of distractor facts that imitate its supporting facts.

We use this relation as a design guide rather than as a fitted model: the specification controls H q H_{q} and K q K_{q} , and the expansion controls | x | |x| .
The central design choice is to generate the world top-down : π θ \pi_{\theta} first writes a compact specification that fixes the questions, their supporting facts, and their answers, and only then expands it into long text.
All entities are fictional, which reduces reliance on parametric knowledge; fictional biographies are likewise used to study knowledge storage and extraction ( Allen-Zhu and Li, 2023 ) .
A program first samples a domain, a set of genres, and a style card that fixes the time period, naming style, and banned names, so that worlds are diverse. The remaining steps are shown on the left of Figure 2 , and their prompts are given in Appendix A.2 .

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Retrieval Data Synthesis
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 检索数据综合

blocks.en:
Our retrieval data follow the task format of MRCR ( Vodrahalli et al., 2024 ; OpenAI, 2025 ) : in a long conversation, the user repeatedly asks for short pieces of the same kind, such as “write a poem about tigers”, and finally asks the model to reproduce the k k -th of them, prefixed by a random string s s .
Instead of using existing conversations, LongZero lets π θ \pi_{\theta} write all conversational content itself, as shown on the right of Figure 2 .
Given only a small set of formats and common nouns taken from the public OpenAI MRCR dataset ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , π θ \pi_{\theta} responds to every request “ write a {format} about {noun} ” R R times, yielding a pool of self-written responses.
A program then assembles each sample from the pool: it selects a target request, inserts N N of π θ \pi_{\theta} ’s responses to that request, called needles a 1 , … , a N a_{1},\dots,a_{N} , at random positions among responses to other requests until the conversation reaches a length drawn from a fixed range, and asks for the k k -th needle prefixed by s s .
blocks.zh:
我们的检索数据遵循MRCR的任务格式(Vodrahalli et al., 2024; OpenAI, 2025) :在长篇对话中,用户反复要求获得类似短片,如"写一首关于老虎的诗",最后要求模型复制其中的k-th,由随机字符串 s.
LongZero没有使用已有的对话, 而是让 \\\\\\\theta} 自己写所有的对话内容, 如图2右侧所示 。
由于只从公共OpenAI MRCR数据集(OpenAI, 2025),\\\\\theta}中获取了一小套格式和通用名词,所以对每一份请求“写一个{format}关于{noun} ” R时间,产生大量自写回复.
一个程序然后从池中组装每个样本:它选择一个目标请求,将 N N 插入到 \\\\\\theta} 对该请求的回应中,称为针头 a 1, ..., a N a\\\\\ 1},\ dots, a\\\ N} 在对其它请求的回复中随机位置, 直到对话达到从固定范围划出的长度, 并要求 k -th 针头的前缀为 s 。

blocks.en:
Because the program decides which response is the k k -th needle, the reference answer y ∗ = s | a k y^{\ast}=s\,\|\,a_{k} is correct by construction, while solving the task requires distinguishing the model’s own near-duplicate responses and tracking their order over a long context.
We sample 1,152 training and 128 validation conversations without filtering.

blocks.en:
GRPO normalizes rewards within a group of responses to the same prompt, so a question that the policy always answers correctly, or always answers incorrectly, contributes no gradient.
In our inspection, consistently failed questions were also frequently defective, for example because two documents assigned conflicting values to the same attribute.
blocks.zh:
GPRO使一组对同一即时反应的回报正常化,因此政策总是正确回答或者总是错误回答的问题不会产生梯度.
在我们的检查中,一直失败的问题也经常有缺陷,例如因为两份文件将相互矛盾的数值赋予同一属性。

blocks.en:
LongZero therefore lets π θ \pi_{\theta} measure the difficulty of its own questions and keeps only the unstable band .
Concretely, π θ \pi_{\theta} answers each question with the full context in small waves of samples, scored by the same matching rule as the training reward (§ 3.2 ); a question is kept as soon as it has received both a correct and an incorrect answer, and discarded if its first W W answers agree.
Because the same model generates and filters the data, the difficulty of the kept questions adapts to the model that will be trained on them.
blocks.zh:
因此,LongZero允许 \\\\\\theta} 测量它自己提问的难度 并且只保持不稳定的带。
具体地说, \\\\\theta} 在小波样本中完整地回答每个问题, 用与训练奖励相同的比对规则(§3.2) 得分; 一个问题一旦得到正确和不正确的答案, 就会被保留下来, 如果第一个W W 答案同意, 就被丢弃。
由于同一个模型生成和过滤数据,所保存的问题的难度会适应将对其进行培训的模型.

blocks.en: From the unstable questions we hold out a validation set by world and form the training set from 2,304 reasoning questions and 1,152 retrieval conversations, a 2:1 mixture. As Table 1 shows, Qwen3-8B keeps a smaller share of its own questions than Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507, 13.1% versus 17.7%, and therefore needs more synthesis to obtain the same amount of data.

blocks.en:
We use (i) Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 and (ii) Qwen3-8B in thinking mode ( Yang et al., 2025a ) .
Each model synthesizes and filters its own data (Table 1 ) and is trained with GRPO in verl ( Sheng et al., 2025 ) for 72 steps on Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 and 108 steps on Qwen3-8B, about 1.3 and 2 epochs of our data, with 64 prompts and G = 8 G{=}8 responses per step, a constant learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} , ε = 0.2 \varepsilon{=}0.2 , β = 0.001 \beta{=}0.001 , and at most 32,768 prompt and 8,192 response tokens.
All methods, including the baselines, share this configuration, and we report the final checkpoint of each run; Appendix A.1 lists all hyperparameters.

blocks.en: We use five long-context reasoning benchmarks: (i) the multi-document QA subsets of LongBench ( Bai et al., 2024b , LB1;) , namely HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, and MuSiQue ( Yang et al., 2018 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Trivedi et al., 2022 ) with F1; (ii) LongBench v2 ( Bai et al., 2025 , LBv2;) , 503 four-choice questions; (iii) FRAMES ( Krishna et al., 2025 ) with oracle Wikipedia articles, 824 questions scored by answer containment; (iv) AA-LCR ( Artificial Analysis, 2025 ) , 100 questions over document sets of 72K–115K tokens, judged by GPT-5.6-Luna with the official judging prompt; and (v) the 32K split of LongReason ( Ling et al., 2025 ) , 794 multiple-choice questions.

blocks.en: 4.2 Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2 结果和分析

blocks.en: Table 2 shows that LongZero achieves the highest average score on both base models compared to the baselines. All three RL methods improve over the base models on average, but LongZero gains the most and is best on four of the five benchmarks for both models, counting a tie on AA-LCR for Qwen3-8B; the exceptions are AA-LCR on Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 and LBv2 on Qwen3-8B. Notably, the teacher-synthesized baseline does not surpass ours, although its questions and answers are written and verified by a 397B-parameter model. A stronger generator thus does not guarantee better training data: questions written by another model over real documents need not match the ability of the policy, whereas those of LongZero are written by the policy itself, verifiable by construction, and filtered to its current ability.
blocks.zh: 表2显示,与基线相比,LongZero在两个基准模型上均分最高。 所有三种RL方法平均都比基模型有所改进,但LongZero在两种模型的五个基准中得分最大,在四个基准上都是最好的,计算出一个对Qwen3-8B的AA-LCR;例外的是Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507上的AA-LCR和Qune3-8B上的LBv2. 值得注意的是,教师综合基线没有超过我们,尽管其问答是由397B参数模型书写和核实的。 因此,一个更强大的生成器并不能保证更好的培训数据:由另一种模型而不是真实文件所写的问题不需要与政策的能力相匹配,而LongZero的问题则由政策本身编写,通过建筑可以核实,并过滤到其目前的能力。

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows that validation scores on held-out synthesized data rise over training for both data types and both models, with fluctuations but no early saturation. More importantly, these in-distribution gains transfer to the general long-context reasoning benchmarks, which do not share the entities of the training data. On Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507, LongZero improves on every benchmark, including LB1 and FRAMES, whose questions concern real Wikipedia entities, although every training world is fictional. Because questions about fictional entities cannot be answered from memory, the policy can only improve on them by reading the context more carefully, and this skill carries over to real documents. The benchmark gains are smaller than the validation gains, as expected under distribution shift, but appear across extractive, multiple-choice, and model-judged free-form answers. The baselines generalize less evenly: they often improve on certain tasks while declining on others. On Qwen3-8B, each falls below the base model on two benchmarks, whereas LongZero does so only on LBv2, and on Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507, Enhanced HotpotQA does not improve on the HotpotQA subset of LB1 (Table 6 ) despite training on HotpotQA.
blocks.zh: 图3显示,在对数据类型和两种模型进行培训后,对搁置的合成数据的验证分数都高于培训分数,但波动不大,没有及早饱和。 更重要的是,这些分配收益转移到一般的长文推理基准,这些基准并不共享培训数据的实体。 在Qune3-4B-Thinking-2507上,LongZero在每个基准上都有改进,包括LB1和FRAMES,他们的问题涉及真正的维基百科实体,尽管每个训练世界都是虚构的. 由于关于虚构实体的问题无法从内存中解答,所以政策只能通过更仔细地阅读上下文来改进,这种技巧会延续到真实的文档. 基准收益小于分配转变下的预期验证收益,但出现在采掘、多选择和模型判断的自由式答案之间。 基线一般不太均匀:它们往往改进某些任务,而减少其他任务。 在Qwen3-8B上,每个都低于两个基准的基准模型,而LongZero只在LBv2上这样做,而在Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507上,Endroduction HotpotQA在LB1的HotpotQA子集(表6)上没有改进,尽管在HotpotQA上进行了培训.

blocks.en: LongZero improves both base models even though each one synthesizes and filters its own data, so the method does not depend on a particular generator. The improvement is clearly larger on Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507, which is also the stronger long-context reasoner of the two. This is consistent with the self-synthesis loop: a stronger model is likely to write more faithful specifications and documents, and it wastes less of its synthesis on questions it can never answer (Table 1 ), so its training data are both cleaner and better matched to its ability. Qwen3-8B does not improve on LBv2, and all methods score near zero on AA-LCR, whose 72K–115K-token inputs leave little room for output within the 131K-token window that YaRN provides, so the thinking model often runs out of tokens before giving a final answer: 120 of the 200 AA-LCR responses of LongZero on Qwen3-8B contain no answer.
blocks.zh: 长 0改进了两个基础模型,尽管每个模型都合成和过滤自己的数据,因此方法并不依赖于特定的生成器. 在Qune3-4B-Thinking-2507上,改进明显更大,这也是两者更强的长文解释器. 这与自合成循环一致:一个更强大的模型很可能会写出更忠实的规格和文件,它在永远无法回答的问题(表1)上浪费的合成较少,因此其培训数据既清洁,也更符合其能力. Qune3-8B在LBv2上没有改进,所有方法在AA-LCR上都得分接近0,其72K–115K-token输入在YARN提供的131K-token窗口内为输出留下了很小的空间,因此思考模型在给出最终答案前往往会耗尽符号:在LongZero在Qune3-8B上的200个AA-LCR响应中,120个没有答案.

blocks.en: All training contexts are short compared with the benchmarks: reasoning and retrieval samples contain tens of thousands of tokens at most, whereas LBv2 and AA-LCR require reading inputs that are several times longer. LongZero nevertheless improves Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 on both of these benchmarks, so the skills learned on short synthetic contexts, namely locating scattered evidence and rejecting look-alike distractors, generalize to much longer inputs. Moreover, the whole pipeline runs on the model being trained: unlike the teacher-synthesized baseline, which needs a 397B-parameter model to write, answer, and verify every question, LongZero requires no calls to a larger model, and its data cost scales with the size of the policy rather than with that of a teacher.
blocks.zh: 与基准相比,所有培训背景都很短:推理和检索样本最多包含数万个令牌,而LBv2和AA-LCR则需要数倍长的阅读输入. 尽管如此,LongZero在这两个基准上都改进了Qune3-4B-Thinking-2507,因此在短合成背景下学到的技能,即查找分散的证据和拒绝外观相似的分散器,概括为更长的投入. 此外,整个管道都运行在正在训练的模型上:与需要397B参数模型来写、回答和验证每个问题的教师合成基线不同,LongZero不需要呼叫更大的模型,它的数据成本与政策的规模而不是教师的规模。

blocks.en: Table 3 shows that the two kinds of synthesized data are complementary. Reasoning data alone already give most of the improvement on LB1 and FRAMES but fall below the base model on AA-LCR and LongReason. Retrieval data alone lower the average. Combining them is better on average than either alone, and the 2:1 mixture used by LongZero is the best variant on four of the five benchmarks and improves over the base model on all of them, avoiding the losses that each data type causes on its own. We attribute this to the different skills the two tasks train: reasoning data teach the policy to chain facts across documents, while retrieval data teach it to locate and reproduce one exact item among many similar ones. The better result of the 2:1 mixture over the 1:1 mixture further suggests that reasoning data should dominate, with retrieval data acting as a basic signal.
blocks.zh: 表3显示这两种综合数据是相辅相成的。 仅靠说明理由的数据就已经对LB1和FRAMES作了大部分改进,但低于AA-LCR和LongReason的基准模型。 仅检索数据就降低了平均值。 将它们组合在一起,平均来说比单独一种要好,而LongZero使用的2:1混合物是5个基准中4个基准的最佳变体,并且改进了所有基准模型,避免了每个数据类型单独造成的损失。 我们将此归因于两个任务列车的不同技能:推理数据教政策将事实连结到文件之间,而检索数据则教它确定和复制许多类似项目中的确切项目。 2:1混合物相对于1:1混合物的较好结果进一步表明,推理数据应占主导地位,而检索数据应作为基本信号。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
We presented LongZero , a method for improving the long-context reasoning of LLMs from zero data. LongZero has the model being trained write a structured specification of the question, evidence, and answer before expanding it into long documents, so that answers are correct by construction without any external corpus, human annotation, or teacher model; it combines these reasoning tasks with self-synthesized retrieval tasks and keeps only the questions the model answers inconsistently.
On two base models and five long-context reasoning benchmarks, LongZero achieves the highest average score and outperforms RL on Enhanced HotpotQA and on questions written by a much larger teacher model, although it uses no data beyond the model itself. Its gains transfer from fictional to real-world documents and from short training contexts to much longer inputs, and its two data types are complementary.
Future work includes iterating LongZero so that the trained model regenerates and refilters its own data, synthesizing longer contexts by writing more documents per world, adding question types that require counting, comparison, or arithmetic over the specification, and exploring better ways to ensure the correctness of the data.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了LongZero,一种从零数据中改进LLMs长文推理的方法。 LongZero让模型在被训练中写出一个结构化的提问,证据,并在扩展为长文件之前回答,这样答案就能够通过构建而正确,而没有任何外体,人文注释,或师范模型;它将这些推理任务与自合成的检索任务结合起来,只保留模型答案不一致的问题.
在两个基础模型和五个长文本推理基准上,LongZero在增强热点QA上以及用一个大得多的师范模型写的问题上实现了最高平均分数和超标RL,虽然它除了模型本身之外没有使用任何数据. 其收益从虚构文件转移到现实世界文件,从短训环境转移到更长的投入,其两种数据类型是互补的。
未来的工作包括延展LongZero,以便训练有素的模型重新生成和重新过滤自己的数据,通过每个世界写更多的文件来合成较长的上下文,增加需要计算,比较,或者对规格进行算术的问题类型,以及探索更好的方法来确保数据的正确性.

Table 5 lists the RL hyperparameters, which are shared by LongZero and both baselines.
Runs on Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 take 72 steps and runs on Qwen3-8B take 108 steps; with 3,456 training samples these are about 1.3 and 2 epochs. The answer-length tolerance of the reasoning reward is L = 128 L{=}128 characters.
Rollouts use vLLM with tensor parallelism 1 for Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 and 2 for Qwen3-8B, and training uses Ulysses sequence parallelism ( Jacobs et al., 2023 ) .
We evaluate on the held-out validation set every 6 steps with greedy decoding and save a checkpoint every 18 steps.
We did not run a hyperparameter search for the final experiments: the configuration was fixed during earlier development runs on previous versions of our data and is shared by all methods, so no hyperparameter was tuned on the evaluation benchmarks.

表5列出了RL超参数,它们由LongZero和两个基线共享。
在Qune3-4B-Thinking-2507上运行,采取72步,在Qune3-8B上运行,采取108步;在3,456个培训样本中,这些是1.3和2个纪元。 推理奖励的答题长容忍度为L=128 L{=}128字符.
Rollouts在Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507和Qwen3-8B使用具有拉伸平行主义的vLLM,训练使用Ulysses序列平行主义(Jacobs等人,2023年).
我们评价了被搁置的验证 每6个步骤都有贪婪的解码 并且每18个步骤节省一个检查站
我们没有为最后的实验进行超参数搜索:这个配置是在较早的开发过程中根据我们以前的数据版本确定的,并且由所有方法共享,因此没有超参数调整评价基准。

blocks.en: Enhanced HotpotQA (from LoongRL). We use the distractor-augmented HotpotQA data produced by LoongRL’s data pipeline, without the UUID key chains of its KeyChain variant. To reduce cost, difficulty filtering uses Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 instead of the 32B model of the original pipeline and does not use a thinking model; questions answered correctly 1–6 times out of 8 are kept.
blocks.zh: 增强热点QA(来自LoongRL). 我们使用LoongRL数据管道生成的分散注意力的热点QA数据,没有KeyChain变体的UUID键链。 为降低成本,难度过滤采用Qune3-4B-Instruct-2507,而不是原输油管的32B型模式,不使用思维模式;8次中正确回答的问题保留1-6次.

blocks.en: The 5,120 training questions (median context 14.4K tokens) use LoongRL’s prompt, which asks the model to end with “ Answer: ” followed by the answer in \boxed{} . The reward follows LoongRL’s exact-match reward: the response must contain exactly one \boxed{} , the normalized gold answer must be contained in its content, the content may exceed the gold answer by at most 128 characters, and at most 32 characters may follow the boxed answer. Validation uses 128 questions randomly sampled from LoongRL’s validation split. Checkpoints are saved every 36 steps. The same data are used for both base models.
blocks.zh: 5,120个训练问题(中间上下文14,4K符号)使用LoongRL的提示,该提示要求该模型以“回答:”结尾,然后用\boxed\\\的答案。 奖励遵从LoongRL的精确匹配奖励:回应必须包含完全一个\boxedQQQ,规范化的黄金答案必须包含在内容中,内容最多可能超过黄金答案128个字符,最多32个字符可能遵循盒式答案. 验证使用从LoongRL的验证分裂中随机抽取的128个问题. 每36步就节省检查站。 这两种基本模型都使用同样的数据。

blocks.en: Teacher-synthesized QA. For each document cluster, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B proposes a question and answer, then answers its own question up to five times and judges semantic equivalence with its reference answer; it generates up to five rounds of increasingly difficult questions per cluster, of which we use only the first round (4,291 questions).
blocks.zh: 教师合成 质检. 对于每组文件,Quen3.5-397B-A17B提出一个问答,然后最多回答5次自己的问题,判断其与参考答案的语义等同;每组文件产生多达5轮越来越困难的问题,其中我们只使用第一轮(4,291个问题).

blocks.en: For filtering, each base model answers every question eight times with its default thinking mode (temperature 0.6, top- p p 0.95, top- k k 20, at most 8,192 tokens), and Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 judges semantic equivalence with the gold answer (temperature 0, numerical tolerance 1%); the answering and verification prompts are those released with SPELL. Questions answered correctly 1–7 times are eligible; after removing duplicated documents, 2,657 (Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507) and 2,644 (Qwen3-8B) remain, from which 2,304 training and 256 validation questions with disjoint documents are sampled. Their median prompt is about 4.7K tokens (maximum about 15K). Training uses the same prompt template and reasoning reward as LongZero , with the teacher’s answer as the only accepted answer.
blocks.zh: 对于过滤,每个基数模型用其默认思维模式(温度0.6,上-p 0.95,上-k k 20,最多8,192个令牌)回答每个问题8次,而Qune3-4B-Thinking-2507判断与黄金答案的语义等同(温度0,数值容忍度1%);回答和校验提示是用SPELL发布的. 正确回答的问题有1-7次资格;删除重复文件后,仍保留2,657次(Qune3-4B-Thinking-2507)和2,644次(Qune3-8B),从中抽取2,304次培训和256次与脱节文件的验证问题. 他们的中位速率约为4.7K令牌(最大约为15K). 训练使用与LongZero相同的即时模板和推理奖励,老师的回答是唯一被接受的答案.

blocks.en:
All benchmarks are served with vLLM; Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 uses a 262,144-token window and Qwen3-8B YaRN (factor 4, 131,072 tokens).
Unless stated otherwise, the maximum output length is 16,384 tokens, the prediction is the text after the final </think> , and a response without </think> is resampled up to two times before being counted as invalid. LB1 : official prompts and F1 (600 questions), without truncating contexts. LBv2 : the official zero-shot prediction script with up to 51,200 output tokens; inputs are truncated in the middle to 120K tokens (Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507) or 79K tokens (Qwen3-8B). FRAMES : all oracle articles are placed in the context; for Qwen3-8B the article text is limited to about 380K characters to fit the window. A prediction is correct if the normalized answer contains, or is contained in, the normalized gold answer. AA-LCR : documents are concatenated in the order given by the dataset and used with the official prompt; for Qwen3-8B the output budget is the window minus the input length. Answers are judged by GPT-5.6-Luna (medium reasoning effort) with the official AA-LCR v1.1 judging prompts; API failures are retried and never counted as incorrect answers. LongReason : 32K split with the prompts provided by the dataset; the predicted option is the first letter A–E after the last “the answer is”.

所有基准都使用vLLM服务;Qune3-4B-Thinking-2507使用262,144托肯窗口和Qune3-8B YARN(factor 4,131,072令牌).
除非另有说明,最大输出长度为16,384个令牌,预测为最终 </think > 之后的文本,没有 </think > 的回复最多重复两次,然后被计算为无效. LB1 : 官方提示和F1(600个问题),不截断上下文. LBv2 :官方的零射预告脚本,最多51,200个输出符;输入在中间被截到120K个符(Qune3-4B-Thinking-2507)或79K个符(Qune3-8B). FRAMES:所有甲骨文都放在上下文中;对于Quen3-8B,文章文本限制在约380K字符以适应窗口. 如果正常化的答案包含或包含正常化的黄金答案,则预测是正确的。 AA-LCR : 文档按照数据集给出的顺序组合,并与正式的提示使用; 对于 Quen3-8B , 输出预算是窗口减去输入长度. 答案由GPT-5.6-Luna(中度推理努力)判断,官方AA-LCR v1.1判断提示;API失败被重审,从未算作错误答案. LongReason:32K与数据集提供的提示分开;预测选项是最后一个"答案是"之后的第一个字母A-E.

blocks.en:
RL training runs on a single node with 8 NVIDIA A800-SXM4-80GB GPUs. Training LongZero takes about 27 hours on Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 and 29 hours on Qwen3-8B, that is, about 213 and 230 GPU-hours.
Evaluation runs on nodes with 8 NVIDIA RTX 5090 or 4090 GPUs; evaluating one checkpoint on all five benchmarks with two runs each takes about 12 hours, roughly 100 GPU-hours.
AA-LCR answers are judged by GPT-5.6-Luna through its API with medium reasoning effort, which takes 200 judge calls per evaluated checkpoint.

RL训练在一个单节点上运行,拥有8个NVIDIA A800-SXM4-80GB GPU. 训练LongZero在Qune3-4B-Thinking-2507上需要约27小时,在Qune3-8B上需要约29小时,即约213和230GPU小时.

blocks.en: We present three types of questions: a fully correct question that is kept for training, a defective question that difficulty filtering removes, and a defective question that passes difficulty filtering and enters the training set.
blocks.zh: 我们提出三类问题:一个完全正确的问题保留在训练中,一个有缺陷的问题难以过滤去除,一个有缺陷的问题通过难度过滤并进入训练集.

blocks.en: C.1 A Fully Correct Question
blocks.zh: C.1 完全正确的问题

blocks.en: Question W188_Q1, kept for training Question: Who was the researcher who used the Vitae Extract developed by Aurora Biologica in 1885? Answer: Sofia Bianchi. Supporting facts: F2 Aurora Biologica developed Vitae Extract in 1885, in Document 1; F3 Sofia Bianchi used Vitae Extract in 1887, in Document 8. Distractors: D2 Sofia Bianchi was the head of the research division at Aurora Biologica in 1886, in Document 1; D3 Sofia Bianchi worked on the development of the Luminosa Antiseptic for Aurora Farmaceutica in 1890, in Document 5. Document 1: “By the end of 1885, Vitae Extract had become Aurora Biologica’s first commercially viable product …” Document 8: “Sofia Bianchi’s work with Vitae Extract in 1887 provides a valuable case study for understanding the intersection of early research and regulatory oversight.” Filtering answers: Sofia Bianchi ✓, Marco Rossi ✗.
blocks.zh: 问题W188_Q1,留作训练 问题:使用Aurora Biologica在1885年开发的Vitae提取器的研究员是谁? 答:索菲亚·比安奇. 佐证事实:F2 Aurora Biologica于1885年在文件1中开发了Vitae Extraction;F3 Sofia Bianchi于1887年在文件中使用了Vitae Extraction. 8. 重点: D2 索非亚 比安奇于1886年在Aurora Biologica担任研究处处长,载于第1号文件;D3 Sofia Bianchi于1890年为Aurora Farmaceutica开发了Luminosa抗化剂,载于第5号文件。 文档 1: " 到1885年底,Vitae Extraction已经成为Aurora Biologica的第一个商业可行的产品... " 文件8: " 索菲亚·比安奇1887年与Vitae Extraction的合作为了解早期研究与监管监督的交叉性提供了宝贵的案例研究。 " 过滤答案 : 马可·罗西 ✗.

blocks.en: The question is consistent with every document: the two supporting facts are stated in different documents, and the distractors give Sofia Bianchi other roles at other times without contradicting F3. The question therefore has exactly one correct answer. It is not trivial for the model either: one of the two filtering answers was Marco Rossi, the founder of Aurora Biologica, who is introduced in the same document as F2. Because the two answers disagree, the question falls in the unstable band and is kept.
blocks.zh: 问题与每份文件一致:两个佐证事实在不同文件中陈述,分散注意力者在其他时间给予索菲亚·比安奇其他角色而不与F3相矛盾. 因此,这个问题有一个正确的答案。 对模型来说,这也不是微不足道的:两个过滤解答中的一个是Aurora Biologica的创始人Marco Rossi,他在与F2相同的文件中被介绍. 由于两个答案有分歧,所以问题落在不稳定的乐队中,被保留下来.

blocks.en: C.2 A Defective Question Removed by Filtering
blocks.zh: C.2 通过过滤删除的缺陷问题

blocks.en: Question W188_Q4, discarded Question: In what year was Soleil Tincture first used by Enrico Vittori? Answer: 1897, from F11 Soleil Tincture was used by Enrico Vittori in 1897. Distractors: D8 Enrico Vittori used Soleil Tincture in the development of the Luminosa Antiseptic in 1890; D9 Soleil Tincture was used by Enrico Vittori in 1896. Documents: “Vittori’s application of Soleil Tincture in the development process in 1890 was instrumental …”; “Soleil Tincture’s documented use by Enrico Vittori in 1896 and 1897 was primarily within the context of specific, localized outbreaks …” Filtering answers: 1896 ✗, 1896 ✗, 1890 ✗, 1890 ✗.
blocks.zh: 问题W188_Q4,弃置问题: Enrico Vittori最早使用Soleil Tincture是哪一年? 答:1897年,来自F11 Soleil Tincture于1897年被恩里科·维托里使用. 分泌物:D8 Enrico Vittori在1890年开发Luminosa抗化剂时使用了Soleil Tincture;D9 Soleil Tincture在1896年被Enrico Vittori使用. 文件: " 维托里在1890年开发过程中应用太阳叮当很有帮助. " ; " 太阳叮当在1896年和1897年被Enrico Vittori记录下来的使用主要是在局部爆发的特定情况下. " 过滤答案:1896 ✗,1896 ✗,1890 ✗,1890 ✗.

blocks.en: The answer passes the faithfulness gate, because 1897 appears in the text, but the question is wrong: two distractors state earlier uses by the same person, so according to the documents the first use is not 1897. All four answers disagree with the reference answer, and the question is discarded. This case illustrates why we drop questions that the model never answers correctly; many of them are defective rather than hard.
blocks.zh: 答案通过忠诚之门,因为1897年出现在文字中,但问题是错误的:两个分心者表示同一人之前的用途,因此根据文件,第一次用途不是1897年. 所有四个答案都与参考答案不一致,这个问题被丢弃. 这个案例说明了我们为什么放弃模型从未正确回答的问题;其中许多问题有缺陷,而不是硬的。

blocks.en: C.3 A Defective Question That Passes Filtering
blocks.zh: C.3 通过过滤的缺陷问题

blocks.en: Question W81_Q1, kept for training Question: Who founded the rail freight operator that introduced the Aegean-1 rail car model and deployed it in Korinthos? Answer: Demetrios Kostas, from F1 Demetrios Kostas founded Aegean Railways. Distractor: D2 Anastasia Kostas founded Aegean Railways, written as a distractor for F1. Documents: “Demetrios Kostas’s role as the founder and first CEO was pivotal in establishing this legacy …”; “Anastasia Kostas founded Aegean Railways, creating a dedicated entity that would specialize in rail freight operations …” Filtering answers: Anastasia Kostas ✗, Demetrios Kostas ✓.
blocks.zh: 问题W81_Q1,留作训练 问题: 是谁创立了铁路货运运营商引进爱琴-1型铁路车型,并将其部署在科林特霍斯?. 答:德米特里奥斯·科斯塔斯,来自F1德米特里奥斯·科斯塔斯创办的爱琴铁路公司. 干扰器:D2 阿纳斯塔西亚·科斯塔斯创立了爱琴铁路公司,写成为F1的干扰器. 文件: " 德米特里奥斯·科斯塔斯作为创始人和首任首席执行官的作用对于建立这一遗产至关重要. " ; " 阿纳斯塔西亚·科斯塔斯建立了爱琴铁路公司,建立了一个专门从事铁路货运业务的专门实体. " 过滤答案 : 阿纳斯塔西亚·科斯塔斯(英语:Anastasia Kostas) – 德米特里奥斯·科斯塔斯(英语:Demetrios Kostas).

blocks.en: The specification prompt asks for distractors that share an entity with a fact but differ in role, time, or attribute. D2 instead assigns the same role to a different person with a confusable name and thus contradicts F1, so the documents support two answers. Because the model answered once with each name, the question entered the unstable band and the training set, where the reward penalizes an answer that the context supports. Difficulty filtering cannot detect such contradictions whenever the model sometimes reproduces the reference answer; a consistency check of the specification before expansion would remove such cases.
blocks.zh: 规格提示符要求分心器,该分心器共享一个实体的事实,但在作用,时间或属性上有所不同. D2转而将相同的角色指派给一个有可混淆名称的异人,从而与F1相矛盾,因此文档支持两个答案. 因为模型用每个名字回答一次,所以问题进入了不稳定的乐队和训练集,其中奖励惩罚的是上下文支持的答案. 当模型有时复制参考答案时,难以过滤无法发现这种矛盾;在扩展前对规格进行一致性检查将消除这种情况。
